user_text: I'm an art historian and I have very little time. Could you show me an interesting painting?

selected_painting.title: A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte

robot_messages.main: Look at Seurat's "A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte"; its pointillist dots shift as you move, making a quick glance genuinely fun. Notice how the green and blue hues vibrate against the yellow accents.
robot_messages.follow_up: Did Seurat's pointillist technique resonate with you, or would you prefer to explore another masterpiece?
